import logging
import time
from collections import OrderedDict

NAME = "antidelete"
log = logging.getLogger("plugin.antidelete")

# In-memory LRU cache: message_id -> message info
MAX_CACHE = 1000
MESSAGE_CACHE: OrderedDict[str, dict] = OrderedDict()


async def setup(ctx):
    """Initialize persistent SQLite storage for intercepted messages and revokes."""
    try:
        db = ctx.get_db()
        with db:
            db.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revoke_log (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    msg_id TEXT,
                    sender TEXT,
                    chat_id TEXT,
                    time_str TEXT,
                    content TEXT,
                    action_type TEXT
                );
            """)
        ctx.log.info("Anti-delete persistent database initialized successfully.")
    except Exception as e:
        ctx.log.warning("Could not initialize SQLite DB: %s", e)



def _get_content_summary(msg_proto) -> str:
    """Extract readable text or media description from raw protobuf."""
    if not msg_proto:
        return "💬 [Empty message]"
    if msg_proto.conversation:
        return msg_proto.conversation
    if msg_proto.extendedTextMessage.text:
        return msg_proto.extendedTextMessage.text
    if msg_proto.HasField("imageMessage"):
        cap = f" - '{msg_proto.imageMessage.caption}'" if msg_proto.imageMessage.caption else ""
        return f"📸 [Photo{cap}]"
    if msg_proto.HasField("videoMessage"):
        cap = f" - '{msg_proto.videoMessage.caption}'" if msg_proto.videoMessage.caption else ""
        return f"🎥 [Video{cap}]"
    if msg_proto.HasField("audioMessage"):
        sec = f" ({msg_proto.audioMessage.seconds}s)" if msg_proto.audioMessage.seconds else ""
        return f"🎵 [Voice Note / Audio{sec}]"
    if msg_proto.HasField("documentMessage"):
        name = msg_proto.documentMessage.fileName or "file"
        cap = f" - '{msg_proto.documentMessage.caption}'" if msg_proto.documentMessage.caption else ""
        return f"📄 [Document: {name}{cap}]"
    if msg_proto.HasField("stickerMessage"):
        return "🎭 [Sticker]"
    return "💬 [Media / Interactive message]"


async def on_message(ctx, msg):
    raw = getattr(msg, "raw", None)
    if not raw or not hasattr(raw, "Message"):
        return

    m = raw.Message
    info = raw.Info

    # ---- 1. Check for ProtocolMessage (REVOKE / EDIT)
    if m.HasField("protocolMessage"):
        proto = m.protocolMessage
        # REVOKE: Delete for Everyone (type 0)
        if proto.type == 0:
            deleted_id = proto.key.ID
            if deleted_id and deleted_id in MESSAGE_CACHE:
                cached = MESSAGE_CACHE.pop(deleted_id)
                sender_display = cached["sender"].split("@")[0]
                alert_text = (
                    "🗑️ *[Anti-Delete Alert]*\n"
                    f"👤 *Sender:* @{sender_display}\n"
                    f"🕒 *Sent at:* {cached['time']}\n"
                    f"💬 *Deleted Message:*\n{cached['text']}"
                )
                log.info("Revoke intercepted for msg %s: %s", deleted_id, cached["text"][:40])
                try:
                    from common import send_android_notification
                    send_android_notification(
                        title=f"🗑️ Deleted by @{sender_display}",
                        text=cached["text"],
                        notif_id=2001,
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Notification failed: %s", e)
                # Save to isolated SQLite DB
                try:
                    db = ctx.get_db()
                    with db:
                        db.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO revoke_log (msg_id, sender, chat_id, time_str, content, action_type) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                            (deleted_id, cached["sender"], cached["chat_id"], cached["time"], cached["text"], "DELETE")
                        )
                except Exception:
                    pass

                await ctx.reply(msg, alert_text)
            return

        # MESSAGE_EDIT: Edit message (type 14)
        elif proto.type == 14:
            target_id = proto.key.ID
            if target_id and target_id in MESSAGE_CACHE:
                cached = MESSAGE_CACHE[target_id]
                old_text = cached["text"]
                new_text = _get_content_summary(proto.editedMessage)
                sender_display = cached["sender"].split("@")[0]
                cached["text"] = new_text  # update cache with edited version
                alert_text = (
                    "✏️ *[Anti-Edit Alert]*\n"
                    f"👤 *Sender:* @{sender_display}\n"
                    f"📝 *Original:* {old_text}\n"
                    f"🔄 *Edited to:* {new_text}"
                )
                log.info("Edit intercepted for msg %s", target_id)
                try:
                    from common import send_android_notification
                    send_android_notification(
                        title=f"✏️ Edited by @{sender_display}",
                        text=f"Original: {old_text}\nEdited: {new_text}",
                        notif_id=2002,
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    log.warning("Notification failed: %s", e)
                # Save to isolated SQLite DB
                try:
                    db = ctx.get_db()
                    with db:
                        db.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO revoke_log (msg_id, sender, chat_id, time_str, content, action_type) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                            (deleted_id, cached["sender"], cached["chat_id"], cached["time"], cached["text"], "DELETE")
                        )
                except Exception:
                    pass

                await ctx.reply(msg, alert_text)
            return

    # ---- 2. Commands for the user
    text = (msg.text or "").strip()
    if text.lower() == "!antidelete" or text.lower() == "!antidelete status":
        reply = (
            "🛡️ *Anti-Delete & Anti-Edit Status:*\n"
            "• 🟢 *Status:* Active & Monitoring\n"
            f"• 💾 *Cached Messages:* {len(MESSAGE_CACHE)} / {MAX_CACHE}\n"
            "• ⚡ *Actions:* Automatically reveals 'Delete for Everyone' & edits in chat."
        )
        await ctx.reply(msg, reply)
        return
    elif text.lower() == "!antidelete clear":
        count = len(MESSAGE_CACHE)
        MESSAGE_CACHE.clear()
        await ctx.reply(msg, f"🧹 Cache cleared ({count} messages removed).")
        return

    # ---- 3. Cache incoming normal message
    msg_id = getattr(info, "ID", None)
    if msg_id:
        content = _get_content_summary(m)
        ts = getattr(info, "Timestamp", None) or time.time()
        time_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts))
        MESSAGE_CACHE[msg_id] = {
            "text": content,
            "sender": msg.sender_id,
            "chat_id": msg.chat_id,
            "time": time_str,
        }
        if len(MESSAGE_CACHE) > MAX_CACHE:
            MESSAGE_CACHE.popitem(last=False)

import logging
import os
import time

NAME = "antiviewonce"
log = logging.getLogger("plugin.antiviewonce")


def _get_writable_dir(ctx) -> str:
    candidates = [
        "/sdcard/Download/WA_ViewOnce",
        os.path.expanduser("~/storage/downloads/WA_ViewOnce"),
        os.path.join(ctx._core.private_dir, "view_once") if hasattr(ctx, "_core") else "/tmp/view_once",
    ]
    for d in candidates:
        try:
            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
            test_file = os.path.join(d, ".perm_test")
            with open(test_file, "w") as f:
                f.write("1")
            os.remove(test_file)
            return d
        except Exception:
            continue
    fallback = os.path.expanduser("~/.wa_app/view_once")
    os.makedirs(fallback, exist_ok=True)
    return fallback


async def on_message(ctx, msg):
    raw = getattr(msg, "raw", None)
    if not raw or not hasattr(raw, "Message"):
        return

    m = raw.Message

    # Check for View-Once wrapper
    inner = None
    if m.HasField("viewOnceMessage"):
        inner = m.viewOnceMessage.message
    elif m.HasField("viewOnceMessageV2"):
        inner = m.viewOnceMessageV2.message
    elif m.HasField("viewOnceMessageV2Extension"):
        inner = m.viewOnceMessageV2Extension.message

    if not inner:
        # User command to check status
        text = (msg.text or "").strip().lower()
        if text in {"!antiviewonce", "!viewonce"}:
            await ctx.reply(
                msg,
                "👁️ *Anti-View-Once Status:*\n"
                "• 🟢 *Status:* Active & Watching\n"
                "• 🔓 *Action:* Intercepts View-Once photos/videos and saves permanent copy."
            )
        return

    # Detected View-Once media!
    media_type = "Media"
    ext = ".bin"
    caption = ""

    if inner.HasField("imageMessage"):
        media_type = "Photo"
        ext = ".jpg"
        caption = inner.imageMessage.caption or ""
    elif inner.HasField("videoMessage"):
        media_type = "Video"
        ext = ".mp4"
        caption = inner.videoMessage.caption or ""
    elif inner.HasField("audioMessage"):
        media_type = "Voice Note"
        ext = ".ogg"

    client = getattr(ctx._core, "client", None) if hasattr(ctx, "_core") else None
    if not client:
        return

    try:
        data = await client.download_any(inner)
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("Failed to download View-Once media: %s", e)
        await ctx.reply(msg, f"⚠️ Detected View-Once {media_type}, but failed to decrypt: {e}")
        return

    if not data:
        return

    # Save to disk
    save_dir = _get_writable_dir(ctx)
    msg_id = getattr(raw.Info, "ID", "msg")[:8]
    ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"viewonce_{ts}_{msg_id}{ext}"
    filepath = os.path.join(save_dir, filename)

    try:
        with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
            f.write(data)
        log.info("Saved View-Once %s to %s (%d bytes)", media_type, filepath, len(data))
    except Exception as e:
        log.warning("Could not write file %s: %s", filepath, e)

    sender_display = msg.sender_id.split("@")[0]
    size_kb = len(data) // 1024
    cap_text = f"\n💬 *Caption:* '{caption}'" if caption else ""

    alert = (
        "👁️ *[Anti-View-Once Unlocked]*\n"
        f"👤 *Sender:* @{sender_display}\n"
        f"📁 *Type:* {media_type} ({size_kb} KB){cap_text}\n"
        f"💾 *Saved to:* `{filepath}`\n"
        "🔓 *Permanent copy secured successfully!*"
    )
    await ctx.reply(msg, alert)

    # If it's an image, attempt re-send as a normal permanent photo
    if ext == ".jpg":
        try:
            await client.send_image(
                msg.chat, data,
                caption=f"🔓 Unlocked View-Once from @{sender_display}",
                viewonce=False
            )
        except Exception as e:
            log.debug("Direct re-send failed: %s", e)

        )

import asyncio
import logging
import re

NAME = "remind"
log = logging.getLogger("plugin.remind")


def _parse_duration(s: str) -> int:
    """Parse string like '10s', '2m', '1h' into seconds."""
    s = s.strip().lower()
    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)([smh]?)$", s)
    if not match:
        return 0
    val, unit = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2)
    if unit == "m":
        return val * 60
    elif unit == "h":
        return val * 3600
    return val  # default seconds


async def on_message(ctx, msg):
    text = (msg.text or "").strip()
    if not text.lower().startswith("!remind"):
        return

    parts = text.split(maxsplit=2)
    # Usage: !remind 10s Text here
    if len(parts) < 3:
        usage = (
            "⏰ *Smart Reminder Bot Usage:*\n"
            "• `!remind 10s <task>` - Remind in 10 seconds\n"
            "• `!remind 5m <task>` - Remind in 5 minutes\n"
            "• `!remind 1h <task>` - Remind in 1 hour\n"
            "• Example: `!remind 15s Check boiling milk`"
        )
        await ctx.reply(msg, usage)
        return

    time_arg, task_text = parts[1], parts[2]
    secs = _parse_duration(time_arg)
    if secs <= 0 or secs > 86400:
        await ctx.reply(msg, "⚠️ Invalid time! Use e.g. `10s`, `2m`, `1h` (max 24h).")
        return

    sender_tag = msg.sender_id.split("@")[0]
    await ctx.reply(msg, f"⏳ Reminder set! I'll ping you in *{time_arg}* for: *'{task_text}'*")

    # Background delayed reminder
    async def _send_later():
        await asyncio.sleep(secs)
        alert = (
            "🔔 *[REMINDER ALERT]* 🔔\n"
            f"👤 @{sender_tag}\n"
            f"📌 *Task:* {task_text}\n"
            f"⏱️ *Scheduled for:* {time_arg} ago"
        )
        try:
            from common import send_android_notification
            send_android_notification(
                title=f"⏰ Reminder: {task_text}",
                text=f"Scheduled reminder for @{sender_tag}",
                notif_id=2003,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
        await ctx.reply(msg, alert)

    asyncio.create_task(_send_later())

import time

NAME = "stats"
START_TIME = time.time()


async def on_message(ctx, msg):
    if msg.text.strip().lower() == "!stats":
        uptime_sec = int(time.time() - START_TIME)
        hrs, rem = divmod(uptime_sec, 3600)
        mins, secs = divmod(rem, 60)
        uptime_str = f"{hrs}h {mins}m {secs}s"
        
        active_plugins = ", ".join(ctx._core.plugins.names()) if hasattr(ctx, "_core") else "stats"
        queue_len = ctx._core.queue._q.qsize() if hasattr(ctx, "_core") and hasattr(ctx._core, "queue") else 0
        
        reply = (
            "📊 *WA Core Engine Stats:*\n"
            f"• ⏱️ *Uptime:* {uptime_str}\n"
            f"• 🧩 *Active Plugins:* `{active_plugins}`\n"
            f"• 📬 *Outbound Queue:* {queue_len} pending\n"
            "• 🟢 *Status:* Healthy"
        )
        await ctx.reply(msg, reply)
